'''Killer Bees''' (published on the 2025 roster spreadsheet as Killer Bs) is a modern Star Wars CCG playtest team. A 2026 GEMPC bracket-reveal stream named it alongside [[New Allies]], [[Team 5]], and [[Moneyball]] as one of the standing teams the Council considered when seeding, calling it "the best up and coming team."<ref name="gempc-br">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rA539EIuVm0 2026 GEMPC bracket reveal], Star Wars CCG YouTube</ref> A 2026 U.S. Nationals stream remarked that "100% of the Killer Bees are on Luke Saga."<ref name="nats-stream">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7jJnb8oZBTU 2026 U.S. Nationals Game 1], Star Wars CCG YouTube</ref>

The published 14 September 2025 roster is Olson's forum spreadsheet.<ref name="forum-81218">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (arebelspy), Players Committee Forums (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). Live sheet: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing Google Sheets]. Wayback: https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing. Wiki copy: [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]].</ref>
